justification: VitePress 1.6.4 (latest release) declares a dependency on vite ^5.4.14; the only patched release (>=6.4.3) is outside the supported range, and no patched 5.x build exists. The advisory (server.fs.deny bypass via Windows alternate paths) only affects the local development server.
compensatingControl: The Vite dev server binds to localhost only and is never exposed publicly. Production serves pre-built static assets from a Cloudflare Workers deployment with no Vite runtime. Team development is on macOS; the bypass is Windows-specific. Revisit on the next VitePress or Vite release.
